verdict.rationale: Intel's Gaudi docs include dedicated guides for running inference with vLLM and SGLang, running quantized models in FP8 or INT4, getting started with model serving, and PyTorch inference. That covers both low-precision formats and supported serving stacks for this part. The evidence is only doc section titles, though, so depth is unverified. missing for 10: FP4 support (INT4 is documented instead), detail beyond doc headings on supported models and quantization workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration of the vLLM/FP8 inference path.
